title: Contents and head position of the buffer tape
statement: Let $m,k$ be natural numbers, let $\iota$ embed the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices, and choose a tape index $\mathrm{cap}$ outside the image of $\iota$. For any initial tape contents and head positions, lists $\mathrm{pre}$ and $\mathrm{out}_0$, and an initial configuration $c$, in the embedded silent configuration the contents of tape $\mathrm{cap}$ are the buffer storing $\mathrm{pre}$ followed by $c$'s output, and its head is at the integer position equal to the length of that concatenated list.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices
A tape index $\mathrm{cap}$ outside the image of the embedding
Initial contents for each of the $k$ tapes
Initial head positions for each of the $k$ tapes
